flow.hint: Select any shortcuts. Real actions remain enabled, including closing, locking or shutting down! Workspace targets, directional window focus (H/J/K/L), closing the active window, and floating/fullscreen changes are checked automatically. Close menus first. If there is no neighbouring window in the requested direction, use Next. Confirm other tasks (or missed changes) using Done in the bar. Next skips; click the task to stop. Select at least one shortcut.
